parts.title: Hop On
parts.text: Isa ran to the bus stop. She had to **hustle** up the steps. Malik sat by the window. Greta did not **dawdle**. She saved a seat for Isa. “**Buckle** up, please,” said the driver.

parts.title: A Bumpy Road
parts.text: The bus hit a bump. It gave the kids a little **jolt**. Isa’s backpack began to **jiggle** on her lap. The bus was **noisy**. Everyone sang. A pencil fell with a **clatter**. Soon there was a **commotion** in the back. Kids were all shouting!

parts.title: A Quick Turn
parts.text: A small dog ran onto the road. The driver made a quick **swerve** to miss it. A car gave a loud **honk**. The brakes made a **screech**. The dog was safe! Isa slid over, and the three friends had to **squish** together on the seat.

parts.title: Safe at School
parts.text: The dog trotted home. The bus rolled on to school. The friends were glad to be together. It was a ride they would not forget.

definitions.meaning2: A sudden bump. Example: The car stopped with a jolt.

definitions.meaning1: To turn quickly to one side. Example: I swerve my bike to miss a rock.
